drop: Drop an MHTML or MHT file here to convert it to HTML
privacy: Your document stays in this browser. No uploads or remote content.
invalid: Choose a readable MHTML or MHT archive with document content.
failed: The HTML file could not be created. No incomplete file is available for download.
unsupported: This archive has missing or unreadable image, style or font resources. Save a complete capture with its included resources and try again.
resource: The browser could not allocate enough resources to render this document. Close other tabs or try another device.
engineUnavailable: The conversion engine could not start. Reload the page or try a current browser.
fidelity: Convert the main saved page into a standalone UTF-8 HTML file with supported bundled images and styles. The downloaded file opens offline and keeps selectable text.
limitations: Scripts, forms, redirects, embedded apps, SVG and MathML are omitted. Incomplete archives, additional pages, unsupported encodings and missing or unreadable resources prevent export. Complex web layouts and fonts may differ from the original.
layoutNotice: This is a safe, static copy of the main archived document. Original website sessions and interactive features are not restored. External links open only when selected; local bookmarks stay in the document.
encoding: This archive declares a text encoding that this browser does not support. Save a complete UTF-8 capture and try again.
incomplete: This archive is incomplete. Save a complete MHTML copy and try again.
nested: This archive contains embedded frames or additional pages. Save the main document on its own before converting.
structure: Choose an MHTML or MHT web archive. Plain HTML and other multipart files need their corresponding tools.
email: This file is an email message. Use the Email Viewer to read it.
missingReference: This internal reference could not be found in the saved page.
